hints.title: Unique Student Deduplication
hints.text: Group students by their bench identifier while ensuring duplicates are counted only once per bench.

hints.title: Bench Mapping
hints.text: Map each bench identifier to a hash set containing the distinct student identifiers.

hints.title: Maximum Set Size
hints.text: Iterate over all sets in the map and return the maximum cardinality found.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of student seating records
complexity.notes: Inserts all student identifiers into hash sets keyed by bench identifier in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated pairwise deduplication causes quadratic comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash sets store distinct student identifiers per bench.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies hash map with hash sets to handle distinct element grouping cleanly.
